race.comment: DRESSEDUPINTHECITY (3) was in the money two runs ago then went well again last time over 1690m at this track, finishing 5.5 metres from the winner in second. Has the benefit of a good draw. Won't find this any harder and she can get the job done. OSCAROO (7) ran third last start at this track over 1690m, beaten 7 metres. Expect him to pose a serious challenge. CARPOPHORUS (5) disappointed last time when ninth over 1690m at this track. Can make amends. NARKY INTELLECTUAL (6) never fired last time when seventh over 1609m at Geelong. Can do a lot better so is worth considering.
